label: RSVP
notes: RSVP common header (8 bytes) directly over IP protocol 46, the signalling plane of IntServ and MPLS-TE (RSVP-TE, RFC 3209). Only the fixed common header is modelled: everything after byte 8 is a variable-count sequence of objects (Length/Class-Num/C-Type TLVs, RFC 2205 §3.1.2), so no byte past the header sits at a trustworthy fixed offset. The header flags nibble has no bits defined (reserved). Message types beyond RFC 2205's 1-7 are included from IANA: Bundle/ACK/Srefresh (RFC 2961 refresh reduction), Hello (RFC 3209) and Notify (RFC 3473); both are common in MPLS-TE captures.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Protocol version number; this is version 1.

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: No flag bits are defined; the nibble is reserved and senders set it to zero.

fields.label: Checksum
fields.description: One's complement of the one's complement sum of the message, computed with the checksum field zeroed; an all-zero value means no checksum was transmitted.

fields.label: Send TTL
fields.description: The IP TTL value with which the message was sent.

fields.label: Reserved
fields.description: Reserved byte of the common header; zero on the wire.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: Total length of the RSVP message in bytes, including the common header and the objects that follow.
